hero.caption:
Side view of the building known as Cloudland at Bowen Hills, Brisbane, Queensland, 1946
Side view of Cloudland, a ballroom in the north Brisbane suburb of Bowen Hills. It was constructed in 1939-1940 as 'Luna Park' and opened on 2 August, 1940. In 1942 United States forces took it over as an office and headquarters. It was reopened as a ballroom again on 26 April, 1947. The building was demolished in 1982.
